lede: Oklahoma State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +2.7 against -0.2, a 2.9-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it West Virginia -9.1 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with West Virginia winning 73% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is scheme fit, where West Virginia leads Oklahoma State by 85 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 79% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
